page.layout: One page of text, single column, with a head block at the top (page number, division title, poem title), then a poem set in stanzas. A catchword at the lower right.

main_text.head: ALIORVM POETARVM CARMINA.
Ad Clariss. virum D. Th. Bezam Carmen.

p.i: ENFANS, quum patrias Beza tenellu-lus Vagitu insolito concuteret domos, Miratúsque nouam, non sine Numine, Lucem cerneret acrior:
Illum Pierides, & Charitum chorus, Illum cum Clario Pallas Apolline Viderunt faciles: vidit & addita Cunctis læta Lubentia.
Montisque vnanimes verticibus sacris Conuenere sui[?]: qua strepit ungula Fons reclusus equi limpidus alitis:
Qua Lauri virides comas Spargunt, Phœbigenûm præmia frontium: Atque umbras graciles consiliantibus Dant Musis. Pueri Cynthius Indolem Princeps laudibus extulit.
Hunc carmen cithara[?] iussit Eburnea Maiorem reliquis reddere vatibus.

page.notes: The woodcut initial E is joined to NFANS as ENFANS. The word "sui" in the third stanza is doubtful: the printed letter looks like f. "cithara" is doubtful: the printed form looks like "cuthara". "Phœbigenûm" and "præmia" are read from abbreviated forms. A stray bullet after "vatibus" and an ornamental head-piece are not transcribed. The catchword "Hunc" is printed at the lower right.
